description:
Activate Oko, Lorwyn Liege's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Kiora's Follower to gain all creature types.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion
